# Humble Home

> Humble Home designs and makes custom furniture, curtains, and marble for homes in Dubai, UAE. Visit us at Dragon Mart 2, International City, Dubai, or book a free consultation. Call +971 55 485 0711 or email enquiry@humblehomefurniture.com. Open Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 8 PM.
